criteria.name: Linter Configured
criteria.rationale: Root ESLint covers apps/api, apps/worker, apps/webhooks, libs and Nest app code, while apps/web and apps/cli have their own ESLint configs. apps/try, apps/analytics-cli, and apps/ast-cli have no app-specific lint enforcement and root ESLint ignores apps/web only but does not prove try/CLI app coverage in CI.
criteria.action: Add lint scripts/config coverage for apps/try, apps/analytics-cli, and apps/ast-cli, then run them from a PR workflow.

criteria.name: Code Formatter
criteria.rationale: Prettier is configured at the root and in apps/web/apps/cli, with root format scripts for backend/web. Formatting is not enforced for apps/try, apps/analytics-cli, or apps/ast-cli in CI.
criteria.action: Add a CI `format:check` job that runs Prettier checks for root backend apps, apps/web, apps/cli, apps/try, apps/analytics-cli, and apps/ast-cli.

criteria.name: Type Checker / Strict Typing
criteria.rationale: apps/web, apps/try, and apps/cli use strict TypeScript configs. The root/Nest config used by api, worker, webhooks, mcp-manager, analytics-cli, and ast-cli disables strict null checks and noImplicitAny, and CI only has a narrow libs TS2304 gate.
criteria.action: Create per-app `tsconfig.strict.json` or incremental strictness configs for backend apps and wire a non-emitting typecheck job that expands beyond `typecheck:libs-gate`.

criteria.name: Pre-commit Hooks
criteria.rationale: .husky exists, but pre-commit only runs `node scripts/dev/check-yalc.js`; lint/format/tests are not enforced before commit.
criteria.action: Update `.husky/pre-commit` to run a fast changed-file lint/format check, e.g. via lint-staged or a repo script.

criteria.name: Dead Code Detection
criteria.rationale: ESLint catches unused imports, but no knip, ts-prune, depcheck, or equivalent unused export/dead-code gate is configured.
criteria.action: Add `knip` with workspace-aware ignores and run it in advisory CI before making it required.

criteria.name: Single Command Setup
criteria.rationale: AGENTS.md documents `pnpm run setup`, and package.json provides the setup script for first-time project setup.

criteria.name: Dependencies Pinned
criteria.rationale: The repo commits pnpm lockfiles at the root and for independent apps such as apps/web, apps/cli, and apps/mcp-manager.

criteria.name: Build Command Documented
criteria.rationale: AGENTS.md documents root build commands for Nest apps and apps/web/apps/cli have package scripts. apps/try and the analytics/ast CLIs are less clearly documented as independently buildable units.
criteria.action: Add app-specific build/run notes for apps/try, apps/analytics-cli, and apps/ast-cli to AGENTS.md or per-app AGENTS.md files.

criteria.name: Task / Monorepo Tooling
criteria.rationale: Nest monorepo tooling in nest-cli.json covers api, worker, webhooks, mcp-manager, analytics-cli, and ast-cli. apps/web, apps/cli, and apps/try are independent pnpm projects rather than centrally orchestrated.
criteria.action: Document the split workspace model and add root wrapper scripts for web, cli, and try build/test tasks so agents do not guess which package root to use.

criteria.name: CI Configured
criteria.rationale: GitHub Actions run backend tests, CLI tests, type gates, e2e checks, and deploy/build workflows. apps/try, apps/analytics-cli, and apps/ast-cli do not have clear PR build/test CI coverage as standalone apps.
criteria.action: Add path-filtered PR CI jobs for apps/try, apps/analytics-cli, and apps/ast-cli that run install, typecheck/build, and available tests.

criteria.name: Unit Tests Exist
criteria.rationale: There are many Jest/Vitest specs under apps/api, apps/worker, apps/webhooks, apps/web, apps/cli, apps/try, and apps/mcp-manager. No app-level specs were found under apps/analytics-cli or apps/ast-cli.
criteria.action: Add minimal unit tests for apps/analytics-cli and apps/ast-cli entrypoint behavior or move their logic behind tested libs if they are thin wrappers.

criteria.name: Tests Runnable
criteria.rationale: Root Jest and CLI Vitest commands are documented/run in CI, and web specs are included by the root Jest suite. apps/analytics-cli and apps/ast-cli lack dedicated runnable test commands.
criteria.action: Add `test:analytics-cli` and `test:ast-cli` scripts or document that their behavior is covered by specific root Jest test paths.

criteria.name: Integration / E2E Tests
criteria.rationale: Backend, CLI, webhooks/worker behavior, mcp-manager, and e2e suites have integration/e2e coverage. apps/try and web dashboard coverage appears mostly unit-level; analytics-cli and ast-cli are not counted as requiring integration tests here.
criteria.action: Add at least one smoke/integration test for apps/try and key apps/web user flows, preferably via the existing tests/e2e harness.

criteria.name: Test File Conventions
criteria.rationale: Tests consistently use `*.spec.ts`, `*.spec.tsx`, `*.test.ts`, or `__tests__` directories across apps.

criteria.name: Coverage Thresholds
criteria.rationale: A `test:cov` script exists, but no enforced Jest/Vitest coverage threshold or CI coverage gate was found.
criteria.action: Add coverage thresholds to `jest.config.ts` and `apps/cli/vitest.config.ts`, then run coverage in CI for the changed app set.

criteria.name: README
criteria.rationale: Root README exists and apps/web/apps/cli have READMEs. The backend apps, try, mcp-manager, analytics-cli, and ast-cli rely on broader docs rather than app READMEs.
criteria.action: Add short README files for apps/api, apps/worker, apps/webhooks, apps/try, apps/mcp-manager, apps/analytics-cli, and apps/ast-cli with purpose and local commands.

criteria.name: Agent Context File
criteria.rationale: Root AGENTS.md exists, and apps/api, apps/web, apps/webhooks, and apps/worker have app-specific AGENTS.md files. apps/cli, apps/try, apps/mcp-manager, analytics-cli, and ast-cli lack app-specific agent context.
criteria.action: Add concise AGENTS.md files for apps/cli, apps/try, apps/mcp-manager, apps/analytics-cli, and apps/ast-cli focused on commands and common mistakes.

criteria.name: Architecture Docs
criteria.rationale: Root AGENTS.md, docs-internal, libs READMEs, and app docs cover core architecture and several services. Thin CLI apps and apps/try have less architecture-specific documentation.
criteria.action: Add a repo architecture map that links each app to its owning libs, queues, databases, and deploy workflow.

criteria.name: API / Schema Docs
criteria.rationale: The API uses Swagger/OpenAPI tooling, apps/try has PUBLIC_API.md, and mcp-manager exposes Swagger docs. Webhooks do not appear to have maintained webhook contract/schema docs.
criteria.action: Add maintained webhook payload/response contract docs or generated schemas for apps/webhooks.

criteria.name: Documentation Freshness
criteria.rationale: Docs include recent plans, generated RBAC/env snippets, and CI checks for some generated docs. Some agent docs contain stale paths such as api AGENTS.md mentioning `libs/core/src/infrastructure/migrations` while migrations are under `libs/core/infrastructure/database/typeorm/migrations`.
criteria.action: Run a documentation freshness pass over AGENTS.md/README files and add a lightweight doc-link/path check for referenced repo paths.

criteria.name: Environment Template
criteria.rationale: .env.example and .env.schema exist, with env drift/coverage CI that checks generated outputs and env usage.

criteria.name: Local Services Setup
criteria.rationale: docker-compose.dev.yml/test/prod/sim files and root docker scripts provide reproducible local dependencies for the monorepo.

criteria.name: Database Schema & Migrations
criteria.rationale: Database-using backend apps share TypeORM migrations, Mongo migration tooling, and migration scripts. Frontend/CLI-only apps are not applicable.

criteria.name: Dev Container
criteria.rationale: No `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` or equivalent reproducible dev container config was found.
criteria.action: Add `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` that uses Node 22.22.0, pnpm 11.9.0, Docker-in-Docker or compose support, and documented postCreate setup.

criteria.name: Structured Logging
criteria.rationale: Backend services use shared Pino logging patterns, but mcp-manager uses Nest Logger directly and frontend/CLI apps have no clear structured logging standard.
criteria.action: Standardize logging guidance and wrappers for apps/mcp-manager, apps/cli, apps/web, and apps/try, and add lint/review checks for required metadata on backend logs.

criteria.name: Health Checks
criteria.rationale: API health is used by workflows, webhooks has a health controller, worker has a health probe, and mcp-manager has a health controller. Frontend health/version checks exist for web; apps/try health readiness is not evident.
criteria.action: Add a simple `/api/version` or `/health` route/readiness check for apps/try and wire it to deploy smoke checks if try is deployed.

criteria.name: Metrics / Telemetry
criteria.rationale: Backend apps and web use OpenTelemetry/Langfuse/PostHog/Pyroscope patterns. apps/cli, apps/try, analytics-cli, and ast-cli do not show consistent metrics/telemetry instrumentation.
criteria.action: Define which CLI/demo apps need telemetry and add a minimal event/error reporting wrapper or explicitly document them as intentionally uninstrumented.

criteria.name: Error Tracking
criteria.rationale: api, worker, and webhooks initialize Sentry; web has telemetry but no clear Sentry setup in inspected files; mcp-manager/try/cli do not show error tracking setup.
criteria.action: Add Sentry or an intentional no-Sentry decision doc for apps/web, apps/try, apps/cli, and apps/mcp-manager.

criteria.name: Distributed Tracing
criteria.rationale: Backend code includes OpenTelemetry/Langfuse instrumentation and AI SDK span helpers. mcp-manager, webhooks, and frontend/demo paths do not show consistent distributed trace propagation coverage.
criteria.action: Create an observability map showing which apps emit traces and add tracing middleware/instrumentation for mcp-manager and webhooks if they are on request paths.

criteria.name: Secret Scanning
criteria.rationale: No gitleaks, trufflehog, detect-secrets, Semgrep secrets, or equivalent secret scanning workflow was found.
criteria.action: Add a path-filtered `gitleaks` or `trufflehog` GitHub Actions workflow on pull_request and push.

criteria.name: Dependency Update Automation
criteria.rationale: Recent Dependabot PRs exist in history, but no `.github/dependabot.yml` or Renovate config is committed in this repo snapshot.
criteria.action: Commit `.github/dependabot.yml` or `renovate.json` covering root, apps/web, apps/cli, apps/mcp-manager, and npm subprojects.

criteria.name: Gitignore Comprehensive
criteria.rationale: .gitignore covers node_modules, dist, env files, logs, local caches, Claude/Cursor local state, test artifacts, and app-specific generated files.

criteria.name: Secrets Management
criteria.rationale: CI and deploy workflows pull secrets from GitHub Secrets/AWS SSM and .env files are ignored; env schema/template tooling exists.

criteria.name: CODEOWNERS
criteria.rationale: .github/CODEOWNERS is present.

criteria.name: Agent Context Quality
criteria.rationale: Root and key backend/web AGENTS.md files are concise and include common mistakes. Several apps lack app-specific agent context, and at least one inspected note appears stale.
criteria.action: Add/update app-specific AGENTS.md files and run a path/command freshness check for all agent context files.

criteria.name: Skills / Reusable Context
criteria.rationale: The repo contains CLI skills, Claude skills, and `.agents/skills` reusable context. There is no Tessl plugin manifest and several app-specific workflows are not packaged as reusable skills.
criteria.action: Create a repo-local Tessl plugin or skill index for recurring Kodus workflows: backend logging, RBAC endpoints, Kody Rules sync, context compression, and Next.js dashboard work.

criteria.name: MCP Configuration
criteria.rationale: The repo includes mcp-manager app/config and some MCP-facing docs, but no project-level MCP server config for coding agents was found.
criteria.action: Add a project MCP configuration/runbook that tells agents which MCP servers are available, how to authenticate safely, and when to use them.

criteria.name: Editor / Agent Rules
criteria.rationale: .cursor commands/rules/hooks and .claude commands/skills are present, but `.cursor/rules/run.mdc` is effectively empty and several apps lack targeted rules.
criteria.action: Populate `.cursor/rules/run.mdc` and add targeted rules for logging, tests, RBAC guards, and Next.js app patterns.

criteria.name: Task Discovery
criteria.rationale: GitHub issue templates and PR template are present, and PR/title conventions plus changelog routing are documented.

recommendations.title: Turn recurring review feedback into deterministic gates
recommendations.detail: Add lint/ast-grep checks for empty catch blocks, missing PinoLoggerService metadata, missing endpoint guards, and service changes without nearby tests.

recommendations.title: Close CI coverage gaps for independent apps
recommendations.detail: Add path-filtered PR jobs for apps/try, apps/analytics-cli, and apps/ast-cli, and expand typecheck/lint/format checks beyond the current narrow gates.

recommendations.title: Make agent context complete and fresh per app
recommendations.detail: Add app-specific AGENTS.md files and reusable skills for CLI, try, mcp-manager, analytics-cli, ast-cli, logging, RBAC, Kody Rules sync, and context compression.
